scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run format && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
scripts.build:mac: rustup target add aarch64-apple-darwin x86_64-apple-darwin 2>/dev/null; pnpm --filter @qedit/web tauri build --bundles dmg
scripts.build:linux: rustup target add x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu 2>/dev/null; pnpm --filter @qedit/web tauri build --bundles deb
scripts.build:win: rustup target add x86_64-pc-windows-msvc 2>/dev/null; pnpm --filter @qedit/web tauri build --bundles msi
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build:mac && pnpm run build:linux && pnpm run build:win
